 Chhath Puja bank holiday today: Are banks open or closed? Check city-wise closures, November holiday list
 Customers planning to visit bank branches today should check the holiday schedule for their respective cities before heading out to avoid unnecessary trips. 
 Moneycontrol News 
 November 16, 2026 / 07:28 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 Chhath Puja Bank Holiday Today on November 16 Banks in Patna and Ranchi closed for Chhath Puja.
 Other cities operate normally on November 16.
 Upcoming regional holidays listed for November.

 With Chhath Puja celebrations drawing to a close on Monday, November 16, bank customers in some cities may find their local branches shut for the day. The festival holiday, however, is not being observed nationwide. According to the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) November holiday calendar, banks in Patna and Ranchi will remain closed, while branches in New Delhi, Mumbai and Kolkata will continue to operate as usual.
 Customers planning to visit bank branches today should check the holiday schedule for their respective cities before heading out to avoid unnecessary trips.
 Chhath Puja is being celebrated over four days, from November 13 to 16 this year. The festivities began with Nahay Khay, followed by Kharna on November 14. Devotees observed Sandhya Arghya on November 15, while the festival concludes on November 16 with Usha Arghya, when offerings are made to the rising Sun.
 When will banks remain closed for the rest of November? 
 Apart from Chhath Puja, banks will observe several regional holidays during the remainder of November. These closures will vary across states and cities.

 November 20 (Friday): Banks in Dehradun will remain closed for Igas-Bagwal.
 November 23 (Monday): Banks in Shillong will remain closed for Seng Kut Snem.
 November 24 (Tuesday): Banks in Aizawl, Belapur, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Chandigarh, Dehradun, Hyderabad, Itanagar, Jaipur, Jammu, Kanpur, Kohima, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, New Delhi, Raipur, Ranchi, Shimla and Srinagar will remain closed for Guru Nanak Jayanti, Karthika Purnima and Rahas Purnima.
 November 27 (Friday): Banks in Bengaluru will remain closed for Kanakadasa Jayanthi.
 Apart from festival-specific and regional holidays, banks across India remain closed on all Sundays and the second and fourth Saturdays of every month. In November, the remaining Sunday holidays fall on November 22 and 29, while November 28 will be the fourth Saturday.
 Customers should note that bank holidays apply to physical branches. Digital banking services, including UPI, mobile and internet banking, and ATMs, are generally available on holidays.
